tips.title: Minimize distance between points
tips.body: Optimally align the component on the machine by minimizing the distance between model positions and real positions using Surfaces (distance along normal) or Points (3D distance) functions.

tips.title: Configure program run (simulation)
tips.body: Simulate the VNC or NC program file, configure views in the split/unsplit window of the block display, control visibility in the graphics area, and simulate the program file.

tips.title: Set simulation area – approach a position
tips.body: Define the start and end of the program run by selecting lower and upper limits, or directly using slide controls A and B.

tips.title: Regulate speed during simulation
tips.body: Move the program run one step backwards, start and stop the program run, or move one step forwards.

tips.title: Run collision check
tips.body: After starting the collision check, progress indicators change based on whether a collision, component violation, or contact was detected.

tips.title: Approve NC file
tips.body: An NC file must undergo a collision check without errors to be approved.

tips.title: Move machine to next warning/error/collision area
tips.body: Use buttons to move the machine to the next warning, error, or collision area during simulation.

tips.title: Save approved NC file
tips.body: Click the button to save an approved NC file in a defined folder.

tips.title: Set reasonable tool contact tolerance values
tips.body: Tool contact limit values should not exceed half the tool diameter.

tips.title: Check tool against model during simulation
tips.body: Ensure the Check tool against model function is activated for accurate collision detection.

tips.title: Use job settings for collision allowance
tips.body: Activate Use job settings to apply part allowances based on job-defined values.

tips.title: Consider core diameter for milling tools
tips.body: Enable Consider core diameter for milling tools to check collisions with the stock, taking into account the tool's core diameter.

tips.title: Derive collision tolerance from stock model resolution
tips.body: Activate derive from stock model resolution to automatically set the collision tolerance based on the stock's tolerance.

tips.title: Derive collision tolerance from job settings
tips.body: Activate derive from job settings to automatically set the collision tolerance based on the job's calculation tolerance.

tips.title: Set clearance distance to fixture
tips.body: Define the tool safety distance to fixture in hyperMILL settings or VM configuration.

tips.title: Set safety distance for MCS movements
tips.body: Define the tool safety distance for movements in the machine coordinate system (MCS, M91, ..) in VM configuration settings.

tips.title: Save collision check settings as default
tips.body: Avoid saving deactivated collision-critical settings such as Check tool against model, Check holder/shaft/core against model or Check stock as defaults.

tips.title: Check for workspace violations in VNC program files
tips.body: Perform a collision check when reading a VNC program file to display workspace violations.

tips.title: Use shortcut menu for status messages
tips.body: Access functions like Save, Move to this line, Show details via the right mouse button on status messages.

tips.title: Use shortcut menu for block display
tips.body: Access functions like Run to this position, Run to line via the right mouse button on the block display.

tips.title: Limit simulation to selected job
tips.body: Use This job only to limit the program run and toolpath display to the selected job.

tips.title: Check tool against model
tips.body: Ensure that the tool is checked against the model during collision checks to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Check stock and core during collision checks
tips.body: Include stock and core in the collision check to ensure proper machining.

tips.title: Set tolerance for collision check
tips.body: Set the tolerance to 0.1 mm during collision checks.

tips.title: Edit NC file
tips.body: Open the generated NC file for editing if necessary.

tips.title: Open output directory
tips.body: Access the output directory to locate the saved NC file.

tips.title: Switch between machine configuration modes
tips.body: Use the secondary navigation toolbar to switch between machine configuration, manual control, and display of machine axis limits.

tips.title: Control visibility of machine elements
tips.body: Manually control the display of machine elements in the graphics area, position machine axes, and show axis limits.

tips.title: Manually position machine axes
tips.body: Move linear and rotary axes of the machine to test machining situations under real conditions.

tips.title: Use secondary navigation toolbar
tips.body: Switch between machine configuration, manual control, and display of machine axis limits using the secondary navigation toolbar.

tips.title: Enter coordinate values manually
tips.body: Directly enter coordinate values for linear and rotary axes of the machine or NC program file.

tips.title: Move machine axes to original position
tips.body: Manually move the machine axes to their original position.

tips.title: Configure display in graphics window and simulation
tips.body: Extended settings allow configuring the display in the graphics window and simulation.

tips.title: Load tool file in .xml format
tips.body: Load tool files compatible with the neutral tool exchange format of the tool database.

tips.title: Show line numbers for VNC data
tips.body: Display line numbers in the VNC program file/NC file to correlate with NC program output.

tips.title: Set minimum feedrate for rapid movements
tips.body: G1 movements with a higher feedrate than the defined value are handled as rapid tool movements.

tips.title: Specify number of replay steps
tips.body: Define the number of steps for the machine to approach a toolpath point again.

tips.title: Set simulation tolerance
tips.body: Adjust the accuracy of the simulation for collision checks.

tips.title: Simulate machine cycles as a single operation
tips.body: Machine cycles such as Simple Drilling or Circular Pocket can be simulated separately as a single operation.

tips.title: Show toolpaths at simulation start
tips.body: Activates the loading of the toolpaths at the start of the VIRTUAL Machining Center / SIMULATION Center, in order to show them directly.

tips.title: Show linking movements
tips.body: Display the toolpaths of linking jobs plus all linking movements between the jobs contained in the linking job in the program run.

tips.title: Set width of tool paths
tips.body: Define the display width of the toolpaths in the graphics area.

tips.title: Show only relevant toolpaths
tips.body: To make things clearer when very complex toolpaths are present, limit the display to an area before and after the tool reference point.

tips.title: Show coordinate systems
tips.body: Display the coordinate system of the following elements: Machine, Part, Active origin, Active transformation, Origin table reference.

tips.title: Set rotation target to origin of graphics system
tips.body: Set the position as the center point for moving the view when rotating to the origin of the graphics system.

tips.title: Activate material removal if stock is present
tips.body: Material removal is automatically activated if stock is present.

tips.title: Use different job colors in material removal
tips.body: In a machining sequence with material removal, the material to be removed is shown in different colors.

tips.title: Use job information in material removal
tips.body: If this option and material removal are activated, clicking on the model displays information on the respective job.

tips.title: Set minimum and maximum rest material
tips.body: Min. rest material: Minimum rest material that is taken into account in the rest material display.

tips.title: Set compare tolerance for rest material display
tips.body: Compare tolerance: Value for the accuracy of the display.

tips.title: Run to start of job in material removal
tips.body: To move the simulation to the beginning of the respective job, use the Run to start of job button.

tips.title: Analyze movement paths of machine axes
tips.body: Perform a graphical analysis of the movement paths of the linear and rotary axes, insert, activate or delete breakpoints.

tips.title: Display movement path of linear axes
tips.body: X Y Z Display the movement path of the linear axes (X, Y, Z).

tips.title: Display movement path of rotary axes
tips.body: A B Display the movement path of the rotary axes.

tips.title: Display feedrate and spindle speed
tips.body: F S Display the Feedrate and/or the Spindle speed.

tips.title: Insert breakpoints during analysis
tips.body: Insert breakpoints, define conditions for breakpoints, display breakpoints as a list.

tips.title: Use control-specific default settings and parameters
tips.body: Variables: Use control-specific default settings and parameters.

tips.title: Connect VIRTUAL Machining Center to Heidenhain controller
tips.body: Connect the VIRTUAL Machining Center to the Heidenhain controller of the machine.

tips.title: Connect VIRTUAL Machining Center to Siemens controller
tips.body: Connect the VIRTUAL Machining Center to the Siemens controller of the machine.

tips.title: Configure Heidenhain connection
tips.body: 1. Clicking Create Connection opens the Configure Heidenhain connection dialog.

tips.title: Configure Siemens connection
tips.body: 1. Clicking the Add connection button opens the dialog for setting up the connection to the Siemens controller.

tips.title: Ping to test connection
tips.body: If necessary, use Ping to test the connection.

tips.title: Transfer NC program to machine
tips.body: Transfer from PC to machine: Transfer the NC program from the PC to the controller's memory. Ensure origins, tools, and machine configurations match.

tips.title: Consistency check during NC program transfer
tips.body: Perform a consistency check before using an NC program to ensure data matches the real machine settings.

tips.title: Error handling during consistency check
tips.body: Errors are marked as Error 1 (cannot load), and warnings as Warning 2 (can load with caution).

tips.title: Check tolerances for NC program
tips.body: Define maximum permissible deviations for coordinate values, spatial rotations, and tool radii.

tips.title: Tool data transfer options
tips.body: Choose between Overwrite all, Create new entries only, or Decide for each entry when transferring tool data.

tips.title: Axis limits and Shorter distance option
tips.body: Check axis limits and the Shorter distance option for rotary axes with a travel range of 0-360°.

tips.title: Control machine in single step run mode
tips.body: Activate single step run mode to control the machine in single step run mode.

tips.title: Control machine in program run mode
tips.body: Activate program run mode to control the machine in program run mode.

tips.title: Load NC program on machine
tips.body: Load the NC program transferred from CONNECTED Machining to the memory of the controller.

tips.title: Synchronize NC program position
tips.body: Transfer the current position of the machine (block number) to VIRTUAL Machining Center.

tips.title: Program halt and resume
tips.body: Stop the program on the machine by setting rapid traverse speed and feedrate to 0.

tips.title: Control elements for rapid traverse speed and feedrate
tips.body: Adjust the values for rapid traverse speed, feedrate, and spindle speed using potentiometers.
